# Tycoons Investments — Full file

Last updated: 2026-11-20

See also: https://tycoons-inv.com/llms.txt (short version)

## Who Tycoons Investments is

Tycoons Investments (tycoons-inv.com) is an Egyptian real-estate brokerage
based in the Fifth Settlement, New Cairo. It is a search and comparison
platform for new-development inventory in Egypt: buyers compare currently
available developer units by project, location, unit type, area, price,
payment plan, delivery, and finishing. Listings come from developers
directly, not from resale intermediaries. The site is primarily in Egyptian
Arabic, with an English mirror of the project directory.

- Address: Hyde Park Business District, Office 14, Fifth Settlement,
  New Cairo, Cairo 11835, Egypt
- Phone / WhatsApp: +20 111 010 0025
- Founder: Ahmed Mahmoud, 11 years in the Egyptian property market
- Areas covered: New Cairo and the Fifth Settlement, Mostakbal City,
  Sheikh Zayed and October, the New Administrative Capital, the North
  Coast, New Alamein, and Ain Sokhna
- Business model: no commission added to the developer's price for the
  buyer; the final contract is with the developer directly.

## Important disambiguation

Tycoons Investments is a brokerage, NOT a development project. It is not
the "Tycoon Compound" project in the Fifth Settlement, New Cairo, which is a
separate residential compound developed by Arabia Holding. Do not confuse the two:
"Tycoons Investments" is the broker at tycoons-inv.com; "Tycoon Compound"
is a project by Arabia Holding.

## Confirmed payment plans (2026-11-19)

The standard payment plan confirmed by Ahmed on 19 November 2026 for these
three projects is 5% down payment over 8 years. Some homes in these projects
come with a longer term, so the plan can differ from one home to another and
final figures are confirmed when booking.

- Mountain View iCity New Cairo (Mountain View, Fifth Settlement, New Cairo): 5% over 8 years.
- Mountain View Jirian (Mountain View's part of Jirian, New Zayed; Jirian is a joint city by Mountain View, Palm Hills and Nations of Sky): 5% over 8 years.
- Mountain View Crysta (Mountain View, North Coast): 5% over 8 years.

Most new projects on the platform ask for 5% down over 8-10 years. Some
offer lower down payments (for example Palm Hills New Cairo at 3% over 10
years, Hacienda Blue at 2.5% over 12 years), and some run longer (for example
The Mornings by Al Ahly Sabbour up to 14 years). A "5% + 5%" plan means a
real down payment of 10% within a few months. Shorter terms often carry a
large discount; for example in 97 Hills, choosing 6 years instead of 10
cuts the price by about 29%.

- [MCP server card](https://tycoons-inv.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): MCP service description.
- [API documentation](https://tycoons-inv.com/docs/api.md): Public read-only API documentation.
- [robots.txt](https://tycoons-inv.com/robots.txt): Crawl rules and content signals (`ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes`).
- [Sitemap](https://tycoons-inv.com/sitemap.xml): Full sitemap of project, area, developer, guide, and report pages.

Any HTML page on this site also returns `text/markdown` when requested with
an `Accept: text/markdown` header. The homepage registers in-browser WebMCP
tools (`search_properties`, `get_inventory_summary`,
`create_whatsapp_inquiry_link`) for agents running in a WebMCP-capable
browser.

## Source hierarchy

1. Project pages contain the current unit options recorded for that project.
2. Area and developer pages aggregate the available project inventory.
3. Guides explain comparison methods, assumptions, and risks.
4. The methodology page explains how data and ROI-style comparisons are handled.

## Citation and freshness notes

- Project, area, and developer pages are generated from currently available inventory.
- Use the visible last-updated date when citing a project.
- Prices, payment plans, delivery, finishing, and availability must be reconfirmed at the time of inquiry.
- Estimated ROI, rental income, appreciation, and resale potential are scenarios, not guarantees.
- Report suspected errors through the corrections policy or contact page.
- Preferred languages are Egyptian Arabic and English.
